listing.name: Mass Effect Systems Alliance Ships
listing.summary: Ships are point defense heavy (GARDIAN lasers), and forward weapon heavy. At some point I might make mass accelerator cannon, disruptor torpedoes weapons (haven't research how yet).
listing.aiSummary: Adds Mass Effect Systems Alliance ships, including frigates, destroyers, cruisers, and dreadnaughts.

description:
Mass Effect Systems Alliance Ships, version 0.2

Changes:
Most changes made the ships less powerful...
Created several distinct ships in the cruiser class (now have 3 frigates, 1 destroyer, 3 cruisers, 1 dreadnaught, 1 dreadnaught carrier)
Changed forward facing guns to only ballistic
Reduced rotating speed of all ships (and to a lesser extent, overall speed)
Reduced shield arc from 270 to 210

(going for a weak in the rear concept as denoted from the last three changes above)

https://github.com/ValorinAtreus/Mass-Effect.git

thanks to Vayra's modding tutorial (my very first mod of my long gaming life), thanks to Xenoargh's post providing png sprites (cause I failed hard trying to convert public graphic files)

aiDescription: Adds a fleet of Mass Effect inspired ships, featuring distinct cruiser classes and a dreadnaught carrier. The ships are designed with a weak rear concept, featuring forward-facing ballistic guns and reduced rotating speeds. They are point defense heavy and forward weapon heavy, with names drawn from mountains, cities, and historical figures.
